statement: MediaTek's second-generation AI accelerator program uses Intel EMIB-T packaging, with yield and reliability described on the Q2 2026 earnings call as on track and the CFO saying EMIB is making good progress.
why: A named external customer committing a high-volume accelerator program to Intel's packaging is a concrete design win that adds advanced-packaging capacity outside the incumbent TSMC route.

impact.mechanism: An external ASIC program qualifying on Intel EMIB-T validates a second advanced-packaging source, expanding total packaging supply available to accelerator makers and easing the CoWoS bottleneck that constrains merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: the second-generation program uses Intel EMIB-T

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript of a customer's earnings call rather than an Intel filing; qualitative status only, no yield figures disclosed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: Investing.com (MediaTek Q2 2026 earnings call transcript), TrendForce
